Requirements Across the Lifecycle

RequirementQuestion across stagesLecture examples
SecurityWho may read or write these records?Collection · Agents
Data managementWhat do records mean and how do they change?Storage · Agents
DataOps and orchestrationCan a failed job be checked and rerun?Data Warehousing · Systems
ArchitectureWhere should storage and processing run?NoSQL · Big Data
Software engineeringCan changes be tested and maintained?A requirement throughout
These requirements apply across the stages, not just at one endpoint

Data Sources for Team Projects

Public data platforms

data.go.kr, Kaggle, Hugging Face datasets

Open APIs

Government, map, finance, or social platform APIs

Web crawling

Pages you collect yourself, within the site’s terms

Your own data

Lab, company, sensors, surveys you run

Generated data

Synthetic or LLM-generated data, with a clear reason

Or a mix

Combine sources; joining them is part of the work

Any source is fine if you are allowed to use it: check the license, terms, and personal data

AI Policy

Do not compete with AI, utilize it!

Takeaway: Data Engineering

  • Define what the record means and whether it supports the task
  • Choose storage and processing for the workload and required guarantees
  • Check results and failures; use observed outcomes to guide updates
